title: Export the TipTap extension surface from the SDK
reason: Requests public re-exports of the same TipTap primitives/extensions bundled by the tldraw SDK to avoid duplicate ProseMirror instances. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve does not expose the described Tiptap configuration API or the tldraw SDK bundle boundary; the duplicate-ProseMirror dependency hazard is upstream-specific.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not expose the described Tiptap configuration API or the tldraw SDK bundle boundary; the duplicate-ProseMirror dependency hazard is upstream-specific.

title: Let people rearrange the toolbar on tldraw.com
reason: Requests persistent tool ordering and hide/show or overflow assignment for tldraw.com, scoped away from its SDK. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's workspace customization already persists toolbar order, tool location (toolbar/flyout/hidden), and pinned tools per workspace mode; the functionality is documented in the workspaces guide. No implementation gap remains for the requested behavior.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's workspace customization already persists toolbar order, tool location (toolbar/flyout/hidden), and pinned tools per workspace mode; the functionality is documented in the workspaces guide.

title: Add snap points for arc arrows
reason: Requests configured edge, midpoint, and axis snap points for arc-arrow anchors, with pinned behavior when targets move. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's connector/arrow model has no corresponding arc-arrow anchor snapping contract; this is a potential connector feature rather than a local bug. The behavior when a bound target moves would need explicit product semantics before implementation.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's connector/arrow model has no corresponding arc-arrow anchor snapping contract; this is a potential connector feature rather than a local bug. The behavior when a bound target moves would need explicit product semantics before implementation.

title: Moving one child of a group reparents the entire group into or out of a frame
reason: Reports an upstream helper substituting the parent group whenever any child is being reparented, despite its comment saying the group moves only when all children move. The issue itself leaves intended semantics open.
assessment: Varve's selection and explicit drop/reparent paths operate on selected root IDs through its own parent-preserving scene operations; this upstream kickoutOccludedShapes algorithm and its group-substitution rule have no direct equivalent. Keep the product ambiguity rather than changing hierarchy semantics without a local reproduction.

title: Arc2d.hitTestLineSegment reports hits for circle crossings outside the arc
reason: Reports angle normalization clamping off-arc circle intersections into valid arc endpoints, causing false hit results. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no corresponding Arc2d primitive exposing this circle-intersection and angle-parameter path; the reported geometry defect is upstream-specific.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no corresponding Arc2d primitive exposing this circle-intersection and angle-parameter path; the reported geometry defect is upstream-specific.

title: Geometry2d.distanceToLineSegment measures from vertices instead of edges
reason: The body duplicates #10554's Arc2d hit-test report, while the title was mistakenly copied from #10556. Its sole comment confirms it is a duplicate and points to #10554/#10556 as the distinct issues.
assessment: The issue comment resolves the body/title mismatch: record this as a duplicate of #10554, not a second distance-to-edge defect. Varve's shared pointToSegmentDistSq computes distance to the segment itself, including the edge interior.

title: Geometry2d.distanceToLineSegment measures from vertices instead of edges
reason: Reports distance calculated from polygon vertices rather than edge interiors. One comment cites an open proposed fix; the later maintainer comment closes the issue as not planned.
assessment: Varve's `pointToSegmentDistSq` projects onto and clamps to the full segment, so its geometry utility does not share the vertex-only distance behavior. The later upstream closure is recorded; the earlier draft PR does not establish a current upstream fix.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's `pointToSegmentDistSq` projects onto and clamps to the full segment, so its geometry utility does not share the vertex-only distance behavior. The later upstream closure is recorded; the earlier draft PR does not establish a current upstream fix.

title: getCurrentTheme returns undefined after setting an unregistered theme id
reason: Reports a public SDK ThemeManager storing an unknown theme id and later returning undefined; the comment says a PR was opened to reject unknown ids. No later merge confirmation appears in the accessible discussion.
assessment: Varve's runtime theme preference accepts only the closed `system|light|dark|high-contrast` union and normalizes unknown persisted values to System. It does not expose the tldraw custom ThemeManager id setter/getter API described here.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's runtime theme preference accepts only the closed `system|light|dark|high-contrast` union and normalizes unknown persisted values to System. It does not expose the tldraw custom ThemeManager id setter/getter API described here.

title: Shapes hidden with getShapeVisibility still act as snap targets
reason: Reports hidden shapes remaining in tldraw object snapping; both comments confirm that PR #10331 fixed it and the separate locked-target question was left open.
assessment: Varve's selection snapping targets pages, guides, and layout segments rather than arbitrary neighboring object edges, so the reported hidden-object target collection is absent. The upstream maintainer explicitly separates the unresolved locked-target policy from the fixed hidden-shape bug.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's selection snapping targets pages, guides, and layout segments rather than arbitrary neighboring object edges, so the reported hidden-object target collection is absent. The upstream maintainer explicitly separates the unresolved locked-target policy from the fixed hidden-shape bug.

title: selectAdjacentShape('prev') with nothing selected skips to the second-to-last shape
reason: Reports previous-shape navigation wrapping to the penultimate shape with no selection; a comment says PR #10601 fixes the seed index. The other comment requests resolution.
assessment: Varve deliberately lets Tab with no canvas selection fall through to browser focus navigation so the canvas is never a keyboard trap; it does not implement tldraw's selectAdjacentShape API. The corrected upstream index behavior therefore has no direct local analogue.
